info.name: Return the MFE configuration, optionally including MFE-specific overrides.

params.name: mfe
params.description: Name of an MFE (a.k.a. an APP_ID).

items.docs:
**Usage**

  Get common config:
  GET /api/mfe_config/v1

  Get app config (common + app-specific overrides):
  GET /api/mfe_config/v1?mfe=name_of_mfe
